source_vintage: EIA SEDS 2024F released 2026-06-26; complete historical vintage
measurement_limits: Energy-related fossil CO2, not all GHG or all industrial process emissions
Electricity emissions attributed to generation location, not electricity consumers
Industrial sector includes manufacturing, agriculture, mining and construction
US industrial total includes coal coke net imports not allocated to states, so state sums need not equal it
Zero policy: source zeros would be retained; none occur in the selected 50-state 2000-2024 panel
Full-vintage revised estimates are not real-time policy-era measurements
Per-capita outcomes can respond through population as well as emissions
No causal effect is estimated by this input package
